correctness.rationale: Two independent exponential color clocks at each vertex implement the one-attempt uniform-time process exactly. Under advancement of all A clocks and delay of B clocks, an earliest-violation argument proves nested A and B accepted sets (including permanently rejected attempts), allowing Harris product association for arbitrary increasing observables. Conditioning on the first triangle proposal gives exact mask probabilities \(w_0,w_1,w_2,w_3\); the FKG minor simplifies to \(-p^4(1-p)t^5[3-(p+2)t]/9<0\) for \(0<p<1\) and \(0<t\le1\). Direct two-site calculation yields nonnegative lattice minors and proves sharp minimality. On K_n at \(t=1\), first-color conditioning gives \(\mu(S)=(|S|/n)p^{|S|}(1-p)^{n-|S|}\) for S nonempty and strict negative minors for every \(1\le|S|\le n-2\). Standalone exact rational enumeration passes 297 finite-law assertions and 28944 monotone-clock comparisons, without replacing proofs.

value.rationale: Association is a full increasing-event dependence property useful for concentration, stochastic comparison, and graphical monotonicity; it is not determined by one-point densities or one particular pair covariance. FKG log-supermodularity is strictly stronger and supports additional conditional inequalities; proving it fails uniformly on the minimal triangle identifies an exact boundary for applying classical correlation tools. The complete-graph negative minor shows a natural robust structural obstruction rather than a narrow arbitrary numerical example.
